tasks.label: Inspect git state
tasks.command: cmd /c "git -C "D:\旅游业务" status --short --branch && echo --- && git -C "D:\旅游业务" rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree && echo --- && git -C "D:\旅游业务" branch -a && echo --- && git -C "D:\旅游业务" log --oneline --decorate --all --max-count=20"

tasks.label: Roll back untracked generated files
tasks.command: cmd /c "git -C "D:\旅游业务" clean -fd && echo --- && git -C "D:\旅游业务" status --short --branch"
